subject: Next steps: hosting appetite & region gating for FinServe pilot
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lema <anna.lema@finserve.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-18 09:22 PDT
Subject: Next steps: hosting appetite & region gating for FinServe pilot

Anna — thanks again for carving out time. Quick recap from today’s discovery/qualification call and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned.

Call summary (2 min):
- Primary use case: real-time credit decisioning for EU customers (low latency, high throughput for API calls).
- Data residency requirement: all customer PII + logs must remain in the EU for regulated accounts; some customers in APAC require data residency in Singapore (APAC).
- Latency target: p95 < 200ms for EU region transactions.
- Security: SOC 2 + customer-managed KMS required for production; procurement will need our security questionnaire filled.

Preliminary hosting appetite we discussed:
- Preferred starting point: Redwood Hosted API with EU region residency if we can guarantee region-only at-rest storage and no cross-region backups.
- If procurement/legal insists on network isolation for certain customers, Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool) or Private VPC becomes the fallback.

Open questions (please confirm):
1) Is the EU-only requirement absolute from day one, or can we pilot with EU-only for production data while allowing anonymized logs cross-region for internal metrics?
2) For APAC users, do you need full APAC residency immediately, or can we route APAC traffic to EU for the initial pilot and add APAC capacity later?
3) Procurement timeline and preferred contract model (monthly consumption vs committed Dedicated).

Next steps we propose:
- I’ll send an initial hosting options brief (attached) that maps Hosted / Dedicated / Private to your residency and latency constraints.
- Marissa will follow up with a quick cost/throughput sketch for Dedicated in EU vs Hosted EU.
- Ben will send the security questionnaire and a stub SOW for procurement.
- Schedule a 30-min technical follow-up with our infra lead to validate the p95 targets and KV cache behavior for your workload.

Attachments: redwood-hosting-options.pdf (short brief)

If that plan looks good I’ll propose times for the technical follow-up next week.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

---
From: Anna Lema <anna.lema@finserve.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@finserve.com
Date: 2026-10-19 09:10 CEST
Subject: Re: Next steps: hosting appetite & region gating for FinServe pilot

Aditya — thanks for the recap and clear next steps. A couple clarifications from our side.

1) EU residency: this is firm for any production PII and audit logs tied to EU customers. We can tolerate telemetry/metrics being aggregated and moved out of-region if it’s strictly aggregated and non-identifiable.

2) APAC: we have a small but strategic APAC pilot (Singapore) scheduled for Q1. For the pilot we need APAC data to stay in-region — routing APAC traffic to EU won’t pass our regional legal review. That means if we go Hosted initially, we need a hosted EU + hosted APAC footprint or a Dedicated/APAC private option.

3) Procurement: our legal team prefers enterprise terms with a 12-month committed contract for Dedicated and expects to see KMS integration details. Procurement will need the completed security questionnaire and an initial SOW to start the review. Our timeline: procurement kicks off the week of Nov 2; we’d like an SOW and questionnaire by Oct 26 to avoid delays.

I’ve copied procure@finserve.com for intake. We’d like the technical follow-up next Wed (Oct 21) — mornings CET work best.

—Anna
Anna Lema
Head of Platform Partnerships | FinServe Analytics
anna.lema@finserve.com | +44 20 7946 0998

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-19 12:03 PDT
Subject: RE: Next steps: hosting appetite & region gating for FinServe pilot

Looping internal next steps and quick plan before we reply to Anna + procurement. Key points and owners: 

1) Residency constraints (owner: Marissa) — confirm whether our Hosted EU product can be configured to guarantee at-rest replicas/backups are EU-only and document the operational controls (no background cross-region snapshot replication for that tenant). Action: ops + product to confirm by EOD Oct 21.

2) APAC requirement (owner: Ben) — check APAC region availability for Hosted and cost/lead time for Dedicated or Private in Singapore. If Hosted APAC is not currently available with strict residency controls, we need to propose a phased path: (A) Dedicated APAC for pilot, (B) later migrate to Hosted APAC when available. Action: Ben to provide capacity lead times + pricing sketch by Oct 22.

3) Security/compliance (owner: Aditya) — send procurement the security questionnaire and KMS integration notes. Also include SOC2 report stub and note about HSM/KMS options. Action: Aditya to send questionnaire and stub SOW by Oct 22.

4) Technical follow-up (owner: Marissa) — schedule 30-min call with infra engineer (Ivan) next Wed Oct 21 morning CET as requested. Prepare a short slide on p95 tail latency expectations with caching.

Attachments to prepare: redwood-hosting-options.pdf (attached by Aditya), security-questionnaire-FS.xlsx (Ben/Aditya), initial_sow_stub.docx (Ben). Also attach an internal CSV with modeled throughput estimates for Dedicated vs Hosted (mvp_modeling.csv).

I’ll draft the reply to Anna/procurement once we get the confirmations from ops and Ben’s capacity notes. Keep replies concise — procurement wants SOW + questionnaire in the inbox by Oct 26 per Anna.

-Marissa
Senior Solutions Consultant | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

---
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Lema <anna.lema@finserve.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-21 15:08 PDT
Subject: Re: Next steps: hosting appetite & region gating for FinServe pilot

Anna — thanks for the clear constraints and timeline. Quick notes from capacity/procurement side:

- Hosted EU: we can enforce EU-only at-rest storage by tenant if we configure data plane segmentation and disable cross-region backup for those tenants. Ops will need a written configuration request for the pilot.
- APAC (Singapore): Hosted APAC with tenant-level residency controls is in private-beta; lead time to enable tenant is ~6–8 weeks. For the Q1 pilot window that is risky.
- Dedicated / Private: we can provision a Dedicated pool in SG within ~3–4 weeks once we agree SOW/commit. That meets your in-region requirement for pilot.

I’ve attached an initial SOW stub and the security questionnaire for your procurement team (initial_sow_stub.docx, security-questionnaire-FS.xlsx). Please confirm when procurement can review — we’ll prioritize.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Aditya — share the security questionnaire + SOW to procure@finserve.com today.
2) Anna/procurement — can you confirm whether a 12-month Dedicated commit is acceptable for the APAC pilot? If yes, we’ll draft pricing and a committed capacity plan.
3) Marissa — let’s run the technical call on 2026-10-21 09:30 CET (Aditya, Ivan from infra on the invite). I’ll bring a capacity sketch.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (617) 555-0220

Attachments: initial_sow_stub.docx, security-questionnaire-FS.xlsx
